data.name: Jed
data.gender_notes: Jed is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jed is recorded in name-lists as “Friend, companion”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jed expresses “Friend, companion”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jed total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: יד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Jed or Yed is derived from the Hebrew word yad which means hand. It is a common name in the Bible, appearing in various contexts.

in_greek.name: Ιδούς
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Idoús is derived from the Greek word idou, which means 'behold' or 'see'. It is not directly related to the Hebrew name Jed, but it shares a similar meaning of 'revealing' or 'manifesting'.

in_latin.name: Iudas
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Iudas is derived from the Hebrew word yehudah, which means 'Judean'. This name is most famous for being the name of Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus in the New Testament.

biblical_reference.verse_reference: 1 Samuel 13:3, 2 Samuel 1:18, 1 Chronicles 7:14, 1 Chronicles 8:33, 1 Chronicles 9:4, Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 3:14, Nehemiah 11:25, 1 Kings 11:21, 2 Samuel 17:25, 1 Samuel 31:4, 1 Samuel 4:2, 1 Samuel 4:11
biblical_reference.note: The name Jed appears multiple times in the Old Testament, often referring to a leader or a warrior. It is also the name of a descendant of Simeon and a priest who served during the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem.
